data.message: I propose a 10-ton-per-person limit this month and in future months. With 25 of us, that leaves 250 tons, guaranteeing restoration to 500 under either replenishment outcome and earning each of us $10,000 monthly indefinitely if maintained. Larger catches risk shrinking or collapsing everyone's future income. I intend to request 10 tons and invite others to make the same voluntary commitment.
